blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createHook` . It belongs to the Workflows SDK.

Expose a hook in your workflow where you can inject custom functionality as a step function.

A handler hook can later be registered to consume the hook and perform custom functionality.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/workflow-hooks).

types.name: name
types.description: The hook's name. This is used when the hook handler is registered to consume the workflow.

types.name: hookInput
types.description: The input to pass to the hook handler.
